|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Darth Vader's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V8-D-darthvaderslightsaber-2020-05-12.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V8-D-darthvaderslightsaber-2020-05-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V8-D-darthvaderslightsaber-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V8-D-darthvaderslightsaber-2020-05-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V8-D-darthvaderslightsaber-2020-05-12.gif]], 12 May 2020).
* '''Original''' ([[Darth Vader's Lightsaber (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-darthvaderslightsabe022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderslightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderslightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Darth Vader’s Lightsaber”. Text: “Deploy on Vader. While on Vader, may not be stolen and he is power +1. Instead of firing, may cancel the immunity to attrition of a Jedi present. May target a character for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 12 May 2020<ref name="img-darthvaderslightsabea5142dd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderslightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 commit a5142dd] (12 May 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderslightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the game text was rewritten (compare the texts below); the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Darth Vader’s Lightsaber”. Text: “Deploy on Vader. May not be stolen. If present during battle, may 'throw' (place in Lost Pile) to add a destiny to attrition. May target a character for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Darth Vader's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-darthvaderslightsabe6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderslightsaber.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/darthvaderslightsaber.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Darth Vader’s Lightsaber”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Deploy on Vader. May not be stolen. If present during battle, may 'throw' (place in Lost Pile) to add a destiny to attrition. May target a character for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.”
